title: 1King's 1630LP Olaf Guide
author: 1KingLoL

Jax.summary: Bruiser lane: space carefully and bait his spells by stepping in and out, then all-in instantly when he misuses them. Short trades are actually preferred here; mix Q and E points as the trades demand.

Sett.summary: Bruiser/juggernaut matchup: focus on spacing and baiting out his abilities with quick back-and-forth movement, then punish a mistake with an immediate all-in.

Darius.summary: Juggernaut lane: throw Q, pretend to walk up for the axe, then step back or sideways to dodge his spells. Bait his abilities and all-in right after he wastes one.

Aatrox.summary: Use the fake axe pickup: Q him, act like you are walking forward to grab it, then dodge sideways or back to avoid his Q sweet spots.

Fiora.summary: One of the few cases where opening with Q straight into E is the right way to start a fight.

Malphite.summary: Tank lane, so slow: rush Cull and Tiamat, aim for 10-12 CS per minute and treat kills as a bonus. Plan to shove with Tiamat and take the tower.

Ornn.summary: Slow tank lane: rush Cull and Tiamat, farm hard and push for the tower. Pop your ult before his E, because R does not cleanse a knock-up and the airborne still stuns you.

Jayce.summary: Ranged lanes are the hardest and the ranged champion controls the lane. Rush Tiamat, trade CS, look for Ghost plus Flash all-ins, and proxy farm behind his tower while they are down. Surviving counts as winning.

Vayne.summary: Ranged lane she controls; rush Tiamat, farm safely and survive. From 6, Q-R-Ghost can run her down in theory, but she may outduel you up close or run Ghost/Stormraider's; proxy when your summoners are down.

general: Level 1 Olaf beats most champions: let the waves meet in the middle and Q all three casters plus the enemy to win the trade, or take priority. With priority, dive on the cannon wave (wave 3) if they are low, crash wave 2 to fight near your tower, or crash wave 3 and proxy farm (good against tanks). Once ahead, don't freeze; perma-push and hit the tower or zone them between towers, valuing CS over repeated kills since kill gold is reduced. Trade with Q into E without autos, all-in with Q-auto-E-auto, and from full HP use Q-R (plus Ghost) as the opener; stay above about 250-270 mana so you can still go R-Q-W-Q. Against Stormraider's Surge avoid trades, take priority and recall when a trade goes badly; Ghost matches its speed around levels 9-11 and the rune matters much less after Ravenous Hydra. He is a stat-check diver who must play around item spikes; when strong, group and dive the enemy mid/ADC on their side of the map, and when behind, farm the opposite side until summoners are back.
